title: Local form of a 0-current at a regular point
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set, T ∈ 𝒟_0(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U 0) and y ∈ reg T (regularSet T, Simon 7.4.1 as frozen in the contract, with n = 0). Then there are r > 0 with ball(y, r) ⊆ U and c ∈ ℝ with |c| ≥ 1 such that T(ω) = c·ω(y)(()) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^0(U) (TestFormOn U 0) with tsupport ω ⊆ ball(y, r). Here ω(y) is a 0-covector and ω(y)(()) is its value at the empty family () = (fun i => i.elim0) : Fin 0 → ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U 0) (y : Euclid P), y ∈ regularSet T → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ball y r ⊆ U ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 1 ≤ |c| ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U 0, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) ⊆ ball y r → T ω = c * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) y (fun i => i.elim0)
